about: How Zhusha moves and hits in Tesu. H = her height skull to sole at play zoom (96 world px). Distances and boxes in H, speeds in H/s unless named mps (metres per second), times in ticks (60 a second). Boxes are [forward, up, width, height] from her soles, mirrored when she faces left; they follow her drawn body (x charScale). Started from the test room's numbers (Dex liked its energy; its code is scrapped): see docs/character/PIPELINE.md, step 12.
charScaleAbout: Dex 10-19: "the pixels of the character and the world are not the same size": her art stays 128 px, drawn 20% smaller (was 1.1, Dex 10-18 "slightly bigger, like 10%"). Her drawn height = H x charScale = 84.5 world px: 0.66 world px per art px, 1.32 screen px per art px when 1 world px = 2 screen px (drawn nearest at screen res); where one art px would land under one px of its grid (a 1080p screen at dpr 1, zoomed out) she is reduced with the feature-keeping rule, never nearest-neighbour (game.ts reduceActors). Her art, white box, hurtbox and attack boxes follow it; her speeds, jumps, dashes and lunges do not. Every NPC placeholder box stands at this drawn height too (20% smaller with her).

units.about: The world's metre: one H (her height) is 1.77 m (docs/character/PIPELINE.md 2.1; ZHUSHA.md). Speeds given in m/s become H/s through this, never through charScale.

run.mpsAbout: Dex 10-16: normal run 9 m/s, the ult form 11 m/s (5.08 / 6.21 H/s at 1.77 m per H). Was 5.6 H/s for both.

windDown.about: Dex 10-16: "the wind-down = after the attack is finished has to go back to idle slower". After a move's last hit its drawing (the follow-through, then its return to rest) plays at this rate (0.72: each drawing holds ~1.4x as long), while the windup stays squeezed onto the hit tick. Only the drawing slows: the move's windows (chain, cancel, move) are unchanged and any input takes her out of it. A move may set its own windDown / windFrom.

q.about: The Q as a jumpscare (Dex 10-15): input to BOOM in 3 ticks (skill_q's hit), then the frame holds on the boom (hold ticks, with or without a target) with a flash, and the camera pulls out to camZoom over the exploded area (centred on the blast's reach, drifting with her) for camTicks, letting go early if she goes camLeave H from it.

e.about: The E (Dex 10-19: Misaka's railgun): the tap holds the frame a beat (hold, flash), the beam's reach destroys everything in front (e_tap's break), and she is kicked back (e_tap.recoil: from tick, speed H/s, ticks) with dust off her heels every skidEvery ticks.

m1_3.lockAbout: Dex 10-19 (later): "m1_3 should be a forward lunge, like a body height or two forward, and lock onto the enemy". Distances in her drawn heights (H x charScale). From tick at, over ticks, she lunges forward (easing out: fast off the mark, settling into the thrusts): dist with no foe; with a foe (the court's champion) whose near edge is within range ahead (or behind within behind: she turns to it) she homes onto it and stops with its edge strike ahead of her (where the thrusts land), never further than maxDist and never into it; it is re-read every tick, so a foe on the move is followed.

m1_4.inPlaceAbout: Dex 10-19: m1_4 keeps her in place: no lunge, her run-in momentum stopped; the hop stays (lane A's jump method lets the move carry her up).

skill_q.breakAbout: Dex 10-15 / 10-19: the Q obliterates everything in its direction over a big area. Its reach (world H from where she pressed, NOT x charScale: a world effect keeps its size when she is drawn smaller; 12.1 H ahead, 4.95 H tall) breaks every breakable in it whatever its HP and hurts the champion; the destruction travels out at 0.9 H a tick (12 H in ~13 ticks), pieces thrown hard and high.

e_tap.hitsAbout: Hit 1 is the tap (the railgun's discharge, drawing f003's burst); hit 2 the pillar that erupts after (f009). The tap's reach is the beam (world H, not x charScale): 16.5 H ahead from 0.33 H in front of her, from the ground to 1.6 H, destroying everything in front almost at once (3 H a tick) and flat along it.
e_tap.recoilAbout: Dex 10-19: she recoils back on the tap: from the tick after it (the frame holds on the discharge first) she is kicked back at 12 H/s easing out over 14 ticks (~1.5 H), dust off her heels.

hurt.about: Dex 10-19: damage reactions read and feel heavy: the frame stops longer on her (freeze; heavyFreeze for a knockdown), a red burst, the frame kicked; knocked back low and long, she skids (friction per tick on the ground) with dust off her heels.

knockdown.about: Thrown, she lands hard: a stop, a jolt, dust, one low bounce (bounce H/s), then she slides to a stop (friction) and lies until she gets up.

ult.about: R (Dex 07:10): r_call > r_flurry > the nuke dive (ours, procedural) > the smoke fades into the transform and r_reveal. Beat lengths from motion/moves/ult_decree.md.
